mapper.insert: insert into seckill_activity (name, dish_id, seckill_price, total_stock, sold_stock, per_user_limit, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{name}, #{dishId}, #{seckillPrice}, #{totalStock}, #{soldStock}, #{perUserLimit}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.sql: a.id, a.name, a.dish_id, a.seckill_price, a.total_stock, a.sold_stock, a.per_user_limit, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.status, d.name as dishName, d.image as dishImage, d.price as originalPrice
mapper.select:
select
from seckill_activity a left join dish d on a.dish_id = d.id where a.id = #{id}

select
from seckill_activity a left join dish d on a.dish_id = d.id where a.status = 1 and now() between a.start_time and a.end_time order by a.end_time asc
